title: valerianoides integrifolia
intro: Valerianoides integrifolia, commonly known as the Valerian, is a plant species that belongs to the Valerianaceae family. This perennial flowering plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Valerianoides integrifolia can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include valepotriates, isovaleric acid, and valerenic acid, that have sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Valerianoides integrifolia have been shown to interact with the GABA receptors in the brain, leading to a calming effect and promoting a restful sleep.
